claims.claim: London used microwave working very well
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a countertop microwave oven, but no heating test, error codes, or working demonstration is shown.
Witness report describes a countertop microwave with a control panel, but does not show grill function indicators, grill element, or a mode selection/working test.

risks.risk: Not actually working (magnetron/transformer/fuse issue) or intermittent heating; witness did not show any heating test.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the microwave running for 1–2 minutes with a cup of water inside, showing it heats/steam and no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs repair / may be faulty).

risks.risk: Grill function may not work or may not exist; witness cannot confirm grill capability from the unreadable model text and no mode test.
risks.proof: A clip showing the grill mode selected and the grill heating (e.g., visible grill element glow or a timed grill cook with a clear mode display).

risks.risk: Door seal/hinge may be weak, causing leakage or failure to start; not shown in the report.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the door closing firmly plus a start test (microwave starts normally) and any visible seal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential door/seal issue (worst case: may not seal properly).

risks.risk: Interior condition may be poor (stains, rust, burnt marks) or turntable parts missing; not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the inside cavity, turntable plate/ring, and any rust/stains from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown interior condition (worst case: needs cleaning or has wear).

risks.risk: Exact model/wattage not readable; affects value and replacement parts availability.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label (model number and wattage) on the back/bottom or inside door frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lower end due to unknown specifications.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turntable ring/plate, manual) or damaged power cord; not shown.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (turntable plate/ring, manual, power cord condition).

proof_requests: Show a heating test video: run with a cup of water for 1–2 minutes and confirm it heats (no error codes).
Show grill mode working: select grill mode and demonstrate it (clear mode display and timed operation).
Provide a clear photo of the rating label/model number and wattage (back/bottom or inside door frame).
Take close-ups of the door seal area and confirm the door closes tightly (plus a start test).
Show interior cavity and turntable plate/ring condition (photos from inside).
List and photograph included accessories (turntable plate/ring, manual) and inspect power cord for damage.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a countertop microwave, but working condition and grill capability are not demonstrated in the report. Without a heating/grill test and readable model/rating label, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
